title: The feed — what is live, scheduled and recent for the viewer, at /social

tasks.title: GET /api/v1/feed — live, scheduled and recent for the viewer

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `GET /api/v1/feed` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with `{live, scheduled, recent}`: `live` holds the viewer's rooms whose relay status has at least one participant, each with the room's id and title and the status's `ref`, `heRef`, `title` (the source's title) and participant count; `recent` holds the viewer's other rooms, most recently updated first; `scheduled` holds shiurim whose start is in the future and that the viewer teaches, belongs to the room of, or that are public, soonest first. Each list holds at most 20 items.
scenarios: The feed groups the viewer's rooms and upcoming shiurim

acs.text: WHEN the relay does not answer THE SYSTEM SHALL still answer 200, with every room in `recent` and `live` empty; WHEN the request has no valid token THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 401; rooms the viewer is not a member of and private shiurim of other rooms never appear.
scenarios: The relay is down, the token is missing, and other people's rooms stay out

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer opens `/social` THE SYSTEM SHALL show the sections "Live now", "Scheduled" and "Recent" in that order, each a heading followed by a list of cards (spec 016), a section with no items saying so in a sentence; WHILE the page is open it SHALL read the feed again every 30 seconds and when the reader's interface language changes.
scenarios: The feed page shows three sections in order and reads again

acs.text: WHEN a signed-out viewer opens `/social` THE SYSTEM SHALL show a sentence that the feed needs signing in and a "Sign in" button that calls `host.viewer.requestSignIn()` (R17), and make no feed request; WHEN the feed cannot be loaded THE SYSTEM SHALL say so in an alert, not show an empty feed.
scenarios: Signed out, and a failing feed

acs.text: Every section heading and sentence the feed adds is in the interface language, inside an element whose `lang` and `dir` match it; the sections are reachable in order by keyboard and each list is a `<ul>` of `<li>` items. (Spec 000's brand heading and diagnostic line stay above the sections, unchanged.)
